decision_policy.anchor_definition: packet['cutoff_at'] of every packet the front-end emits — i.e. the available_at of the camera observation that fired. Never back-dated to an earlier observation, never forward-dated to a later peak.
decision_policy.anchor_set: every packet: VISUAL + DIGITAL + PUBLIC_TIME. A DIGITAL packet emitted while the camera is active still carries the newest frame (FrontEnd._emit falls back to last_image), so the agent does look at the picture at that instant.
decision_policy.cold_start: the first camera frame of the stream emits an initialisation packet regardless of score, and it is counted in the anchor set but excluded from the VISUAL-only count.
decision_policy.heartbeat_note: DISABLED, and this is a deviation from configs/default.yaml's 900 s. Every number this contract is based on was measured with the heartbeat off (P22 'no heartbeat', P23 A'). Replaying with the production beat adds ~7.9k calls a year and makes the rule look as though it barely fires. In replay_learned this is heartbeat_s = 10**9.
decision_policy.latch: fired on the first observation whose score >= theta_on while the latch is open; the latch closes and reopens on score <= theta_off OR on 120 s elapsed since the last trigger, whichever comes first. The step that reopens the latch does not fire.
decision_policy.score_state: carried within a camera session and reset between sessions (Sessions.span_of, from observation_intervals), which is how the head was trained. The latch state is NOT reset at session boundaries — it runs continuously over the prefix, as in P22/P23.

development.selection_bias: These dev numbers chose the epoch and the thresholds, so they are optimistic. The unbiased estimate is FE_TEST, which has not been read.

encoder.layer: last_hidden_state patch mean (patch_mean), L2 normalised per frame
encoder.note: patch_mean_full.npz is the union of the 2019 and 2020 caches; the overlapping rows were verified identical to 200 sampled rows each.

evidence.two_units_note: The learned arm's headline count is agent calls (19,471); the pHash baselines it is compared against are stated in VISUAL triggers (43,966). The two units are not interchangeable — year_2019_table.json carries both for every arm.

ensemble.combination: arithmetic mean of the raw logits, joined on observation_id
ensemble.why: P10: averaging the seeds beats any single seed on dev. The join key matters — an earlier script paired scores with timestamps by position and reported a headline 80.6% where the honest number was 46.5%.

front_end.head: gru
front_end.selection: 2020-05-22..31 dev, highest F1 over the swept rule family (train.evaluate_dev); reproduced bit-for-bit in year_2019_table.json

head_choice.caveat: The TCN's replacement point had to widen the hysteresis band because its theta_on quantile grid is saturated at the 99.5th percentile of dev scores; 'the TCN has no low-budget operating point' therefore holds within the swept family, not in general. Seed-to-seed stability was not measured with a common selection function and must not be cited for either head.
head_choice.reading: At equal budget the TCN loses on all three metrics (F1 0.5064 vs 0.5172), so its recall advantage at its own optimum (0.7337) is bought with calls, not with a better representation. The project's objective is fewer interruptions for the same service value, so the tied-on-F1 arm that fires less is the one to ship.

result.verdict: GRU dominates: same F1 at fewer calls

head_choice.switch_condition: Pick tcn_ensemble instead only if the deployment objective changes to recall-first with ~10% more budget. Its contract would be cvtt_exp/data/runs/checkpoints/y2020_tcn_5m_seed{11,23,37}.pt at theta 2.135893/-0.365047, refractory 120.0 s, heartbeat off — worth 21344 calls for recall 0.7337.

packet_policy.note: Inherited unchanged from the harness; the learned arm differs only in where VISUAL triggers come from.

provenance_note: 2019 is entirely outside the training window (2020-01-01..2020-05-21), so the verification numbers are out-of-sample. But only 2019-01 differs from the earlier frozen final/ release (217 fields over 1,104 segments, 3 of them is_meaningless flags that change which boundaries are scored); 2019-02 and 2019-03 are bitwise identical.
scope: The front-end decision only: which instants are emitted as anchors. No agent, retrieval, service or delivery evaluator was run against these numbers.

match_protocol.note: lead is the annotation's own uncertainty (frames arrive every ~32 s); dropping it rejects correct detections.

verification.tolerance_note: P23's printed theta was the rounded 1.927 and gave 19,468 calls; the unrounded dev-selected value used here gives 19,471. A three-call difference is the rounding, not a pipeline change.
